title: Awe Concepts — 71-target production progress (19 existing redesigns + 52 new prospects)
scope: Strictly the 19 selected existing sites and the 52 new prospect records. Do NOT touch the 149 archived sources.
integrityRules: Never fabricate menu items, prices, hours, addresses, staff bios, histories, testimonials or booking info.
Publish a prospect ONLY after it is added to qa/active-previews-allowlist.json following individual verification.
Filing-stage leads (43 of 52) have no verified public website/IG/email and are NOT buildable without corroboration.
Archived 149 sources stay in GitHub, never on live Hosting / index / sitemap / manifest.
